$schema_note: Truth Judgment golden set — manufacturing-s8b#line-A. Each case scripts the LLM responses for graphcheck (atomic claim decomposition) and per-claim verdict so we can deterministically validate the aggregation pipeline. Real-LLM eval requires deployed AOAI + seeded AI Search corpus (Phase 2).

labels.supported: claim aligns with existing corpus (≥3 hits, no diverging superseded_by/coexisting_views)
labels.novel: claim has insufficient corpus support (<3 hits) and FactCheck ensemble votes 'novel' or mixed-supported-with-novel
labels.conflict: claim contradicts ≥2 corpus entries marked superseded_by or coexisting_views, OR ensemble majority votes 'conflict'

cases.reasoning: 全 atomic claim が既存 corpus と一致 (≥3 hits, no diverging)
